Our Story

Hello, we're Peak Events

Peak Events by KRD was founded by Kellie Roberts on a simple belief: rentals shouldn't be an afterthought. The right chair, the right table, the right light can set the entire mood of a celebration.

Based in Austin, Texas, we curate a collection that feels collected rather than catalogued: warm bentwood and woven cane, sculptural burl and travertine tables, softly draped chandeliers and bar facades that can be rebuilt in your colors. Every piece is chosen for how it photographs, how it feels and how well it plays with others.

We work with couples, planners, designers and hosts to bring a vision to life, from intimate garden dinners to full Hill Country weddings. You bring the ideas. We'll bring the pieces, deliver them, set them and take them away when the last guest leaves.

What we care about

  • Design first. A tight, considered collection instead of endless options.
  • Making it personal. Custom facades, wraps and palettes so your event looks like you.
  • Easy, warm service. Clear quotes, quick answers and white-glove delivery.
